summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of static luxury editorial portfolio for Anita George. All 16 listed features pass: home page, search routing, tabs nav, projects masonry (5 pins), project detail (vanta-ai), AI Mode, Images + modal, Videos, Research, PAA (7 accordion items), Shopping, Contact (display-only links), Archive, More, sticky header on scroll, no horizontal overflow at 1920x800. Zero console errors. Two initial false-fail artifacts in test were resolved on inspection (see notes).
critical_code_review_comments: All interactive elements have data-testid attributes — good testability.
Sticky header uses data-testid='sticky-search-header' (not 'sticky-header') — minor naming consistency note for any external test harnesses.
Contact page contains a <form> element only because SearchBar wraps its input in a form; no actual contact-form inputs exist (display-only spec satisfied).
